main_text.l: XIX. Excipit Rever. Episcopus his verbis: Imò ita separat conjuges, ut se invi-

l.i: cem infinitis periculis non impetant, & poenitentiæ ac reconciliationi spem & locum re-

main_text.l: Equidem fiageretur tantum de di-
scordiis domesticis, quæ interdum ex occulta antipathia, citra defertionem aut adul-
terium, nascuntur inter conjuges, non penitus forte improbandum foret eos ad tem-

liationem

page.notes: Page is largely legible. Greek passage in the Theodoretus quotation is printed with uncertain letters and is transcribed as best read; the "[?]" marks were omitted for brevity, so treat the Greek as approximate. Some words in the Italic passages (e.g. "Quod propofuisti") are printed with long s and are rendered as plain s. The final line "liationem" is the printed catchword-like continuation, set right-aligned at the foot, not a catchword as such.
